personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK (adapted for Driving Instrument Cluster)
personality_one_liner: A driving-optimized instrument cluster that makes tax and expense tracking feel like checking your car's dashboard.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and spacing optimized for quick glances. No dense clusters.

dont's: No glass UI per user choice (use soft borders instead of shadows and solid dark theme surfaces)

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing live net earnings, today's business distance, and recent activity.

states.empty: No trips logged yet - 'Start driving' prompt
states.error: Unable to load dashboard, Retry button

screens.layout: Header with date/greeting. Top Hero Card: Live net earnings with navy->sky gradient background. Secondary row: Business distance & Recurring payment status cards. List: Recent activity (last 8 entries). Fixed bottom CTA for logging trip/expense.

screens.name: Trips
screens.purpose: Log and review trips, categorized by Business or Personal usage.

states.empty: Illustration of car with 'No trips recorded'
states.error: Unable to load trips, Retry button

screens.layout: Top gauge: Business-use %. List of trips grouped by date, showing total km, route, and Business/Personal toggle badge on each row.

screens.name: Expenses
screens.purpose: Log expenses via manual entry or receipt scan.

states.empty: Illustration of receipt with 'Add your first expense'
states.error: Unable to load expenses, Retry button

screens.layout: Top section: Category breakdown (Fuel, Tolls, Vehicle, Phone). Two large equal-weight side-by-side buttons: 'Add Expense' & 'Scan Receipt'. Below: Expense history list with tax-treatment badges per line.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: Generate and view BAS/GST tax summary and export to CSV.

screens.layout: Period selector (Week/Month/Quarter/Year). Vehicle deduction breakdown chart/card. Main card: BAS/GST summary with ATO field codes (G1, 1A, 1B). Footer: Official ATO link and CSV export button.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage tax setup, vehicle details, and app preferences.

states.error: Unable to load settings, Retry button

screens.layout: Standard list layout. Sections: Profile/Work Type, Vehicle Ownership & Recurring Payment card, Tax Setup status card, Linked Platforms, App Theme toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user's locked color palette. Use the defined dark/light themes.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for display numerals and 'Inter' for body text. Ensure all monetary figures use 'tabular-nums' so digits don't jitter as they update.
Apply rounded corners and soft borders instead of shadows per the user request.
Hero elements (earnings card, primary buttons) must use the specific 'navy->sky' gradient (#0B2545 to #2E7FC2).
Profit must be #2BD47D (Dark) / #12A25A (Light) and Loss must be #FF5C5C (Dark) / #D93A3A (Light) consistently.
The UI should feel like a driving instrument cluster. Use right-aligned tabular figures in tables/lists.
No passive autoplay loops for motion. Motion should be purposeful and driven by user input (scroll, tap).
Include the tagline 'Drive. Track. Done.' in the appropriate prominent place, like onboarding or splash screen.
